chapter: Kid Ory, Hampton, Ellington and Ben Webster
title: Hiring Ben Webster and the drunken fight
summary: Webster got drunk on the job and wanted to fight; Mingus ran from him.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Yeah. Why did Ben spend most of his time in the last years in Europe?
I don't know. I know I hired him and Ben Webster and Coleman Hawkins (unintelligible) started a guest star thing.
And he got drunk on the job and wanted to fight me.
That was the thing. He had a terrible temper when he got drunk.
He didn't get -- he wanted to fight me inside the club. Something happened outside, I don't know what it was. I ran from that son-of-a-gun.
I got in a cab and got away from him.
